action_items.detail: Older-phase backend tests (test_tscheck_engine_phase2.py x3, test_tscheck_seed_route.py, test_tscheck_settings.py) fail against step2 seed (14 requests vs 10, changed usual price $14 floor). Not in this matrix; they look outdated, not new regressions. Please confirm and update or retire them.
WebSocket console error ws://localhost:443/ws is dev-server HMR noise, so it was ignored. Live refreshes happened within ~6s with no reload.

checks.name: flow-b-accept-by-text
checks.evidence: Sent the Van 4 4:15pm $35 option, then typed 'ok'. Without a reload the request status and inbox row 4 changed to Accepted, the driver phone showed Lakeshore, and the Van 4 timeline showed 4:15pm.

checks.name: decline-chip-refresh
checks.evidence: After Decline on the customer phone, inbox-row-status-2 and request-status showed Declined within 6s with no reload.

checks.name: customer-text-live-refresh
checks.evidence: phone-customer-typing was visible, then 'Thanks! We're pricing that now.' appeared. The rail inbox count went up live and the new row 15 appeared with no reload. Its details showed College.

checks.name: customer-text-and-ask-customer
checks.evidence: The drafted question was sent and appeared on the customer phone.

checks.name: flow-a-accept-undo
checks.evidence: After Accept on the $11 Van 2 option, Accepted showed with no reload and Van 2 had 22 stops. After Undo it had 20 stops and the driver phone showed 'Change cancelled'. Ended with a demo reset.
